name: dse-econ-graph

about.en: Paste a DSE Economics question and its marking scheme into Grok, Claude or ChatGPT and get the diagram in the HKEAA marking-scheme style, in English or Chinese.
about.zh: 把 DSE 經濟題目和評卷參考貼到 Grok、Claude 或 ChatGPT，即可得到 HKEAA 評卷參考風格的圖，中英文皆可。

en: Nothing changes in how you use the skill. Behind the scenes, every diagram now has a Chinese title and a short description, so DSEconMentor's AI tutor can show these same diagrams to students.
zh: 使用方法不變。每幅圖現已附中文標題及簡短說明，讓 DSEconMentor 的 AI 導師可以向學生展示同一批圖。

description.en: The file to download for Grok or Claude (ChatGPT has its own version below). Do not unzip it.
description.zh: Grok 或 Claude 用的下載檔案（ChatGPT 另有專用版本）。不用解壓。

description.en: The ChatGPT version: upload it with Plugins ▸ Upload plugin. Do not unzip it.
description.zh: ChatGPT 專用版本：在 Plugins ▸ Upload plugin 上載，不用解壓。

description.en: Only if your AI cannot open the .zip: the guide on its own (also inside the zip).
description.zh: 只在 AI 打不開 .zip 時使用：單獨的指南（.zip 內已包含）。

description.en: The text to paste into your Grok or ChatGPT project's Instructions (also inside the zip).
description.zh: 貼到 Grok 或 ChatGPT 專案 Instructions（指示）的文字（.zip 內已包含）。

description.en: The same guide as a .txt file, for chats that do not accept .md.
description.zh: 同一份指南的 .txt 版本，供不接受 .md 的對話使用。

instructions_text:
You draw HKDSE Economics diagrams in the black-and-white HKEAA marking-scheme style. Your guide is SKILL.md of the dse-econ-graph skill: the installed skill or plugin, or inside dse-econ-graph.zip in this project's files (unzip it with your code tool). Read SKILL.md in full before your first diagram and always follow it exactly.

The teacher only pastes a question and its marking scheme. That always means: draw the diagram(s) for it and reply with the picture(s) ONLY.

1. Never ask questions. Decide the diagram yourself from the question and the marking scheme. Every "indicate / illustrate in the diagram" point must be visible and labelled.
2. Language = the language of the pasted question (Chinese -> 中文 labels, English -> English). Both only if asked.
3. One picture per part that needs a diagram ((b)(i), (b)(ii) ...).
4. Write ONE Python script: first the library (import it from the skill folder: import sys; sys.path.insert(0, "<folder with dsegraph.py>"); from dsegraph import *), then the diagram, starting from the matching template in SKILL.md. Do not pip install or download anything.
5. Run it with your code tool. Check the picture against the guide's checklist; fix and run again silently.
6. Reply with the picture(s) only: no code, no explanation, no questions. With several pictures, only the part label above each.
7. If the output says "NO CHINESE FONT", or the picture does not appear, or you cannot run code: follow the guide (one short line + the script as one code block for colab.new).
8. If the teacher asks for a change in words, redraw and reply with the new picture only.

title.zh: Grok（建議使用，香港可直接使用）

en: Download dse-econ-graph.zip. Do not unzip it.
Go to grok.com and sign in. In the sidebar, click Plugins, then open the Skills tab.
Click Add skill ▸ Upload skill file, and choose dse-econ-graph.zip. That's all: no instructions text is needed.
To draw: start any new chat and paste the question. If Grok does not use the skill by itself, begin with "Use the dse-econ-graph skill."
zh: 下載 dse-econ-graph.zip，不用解壓。
前往 grok.com 並登入。在側邊欄按「插件」，再打開「技能」分頁。
按「新增技能」▸「上傳技能檔案」，選擇 dse-econ-graph.zip。完成，不用另外輸入指示文字。
要畫圖時：開始任何新對話，貼上題目。如 Grok 沒有自動使用這個技能，在訊息開頭加上「使用 dse-econ-graph 技能。」

title.en: Claude (needs a VPN in Hong Kong)

en: Download dse-econ-graph.zip. Do not unzip it.
Go to claude.ai (web or app) and sign in. Open Settings ▸ Capabilities and turn on "Code execution and file creation".
On the same page, under Skills, click Upload skill and choose dse-econ-graph.zip.
To draw: start any new chat. Claude uses the skill by itself, with no instructions needed.
zh: 下載 dse-econ-graph.zip，不用解壓。
前往 claude.ai（網頁版或 App）並登入。打開 Settings ▸ Capabilities，開啟「Code execution and file creation」。
在同一頁的 Skills 下按 Upload skill，選擇 dse-econ-graph.zip。
要畫圖時：開始任何新對話，Claude 會自動使用這個技能，不用另外輸入指示。

title.en: ChatGPT (needs a VPN in Hong Kong)

en: Download dse-econ-graph-chatgpt.zip (the ChatGPT version). Do not unzip it.
Go to chatgpt.com and sign in. In the sidebar, open Plugins ▸ Upload plugin, and choose dse-econ-graph-chatgpt.zip.
In the sidebar, click New project, e.g. "DSE Economics Diagrams". In its settings, paste the instructions text (below) into Instructions.
To draw: start a new chat inside the project.
zh: 下載 dse-econ-graph-chatgpt.zip（ChatGPT 專用版本），不用解壓。
前往 chatgpt.com 並登入。在側邊欄打開 Plugins ▸ Upload plugin，選擇 dse-econ-graph-chatgpt.zip。
在側邊欄按 New project（新專案），例如「DSE 經濟圖」。在專案設定中，把指示文字（見下方）貼到 Instructions（指示）。
要畫圖時：在該專案內開始新對話。

title.zh: 畫圖（任何 AI 都一樣）

en: Paste the question and its marking scheme. Nothing else is needed.
The AI replies with the finished diagram: in Chinese for a Chinese question, in English for an English one, one picture per part.
Right-click the picture ▸ Save image as… and put it in your worksheet.
Want a change? Say it in words, e.g. "make demand steeper", "move 'shortage' lower" or "English too", and it draws it again.
If the AI gives you code instead of a picture: open colab.new, paste the code, and press ▶. The picture appears and downloads.
zh: 貼上題目和評卷參考即可，不用再寫其他指示。
AI 會直接回覆畫好的圖：中文題目畫中文圖，英文題目畫英文圖，每一分題一張。
在圖片上按右鍵 ▸「另存圖片」，即可放進工作紙。
要修改？直接用文字說，例如「需求曲線畫斜一點」、「把『短缺』移低一點」或「也要英文版」，它會重畫。
如果 AI 給你程式碼而不是圖片：打開 colab.new，貼上程式碼，按 ▶，圖片會顯示並自動下載。

title.zh: 快速方法（不用建立專案）

en: Start a new chat in your AI and attach dse-econ-graph.zip.
Type: "Use the attached dse-econ-graph skill." Then paste the question and its marking scheme.
Next time, attach dse-econ-graph.zip again in the new chat.
zh: 在 AI 開始新對話，附加 dse-econ-graph.zip。
輸入：「使用附件的 dse-econ-graph 技能。」然後貼上題目和評卷參考。
下次開新對話時，再附加一次 dse-econ-graph.zip。

title.en: When there is a new version

en: Download the zip again (dse-econ-graph.zip, or dse-econ-graph-chatgpt.zip for ChatGPT).

Grok: in Plugins ▸ Skills, remove the old dse-econ-graph skill and upload the new dse-econ-graph.zip. ChatGPT: upload the new dse-econ-graph-chatgpt.zip with Plugins ▸ Upload plugin. If the instructions text changed, paste the new text into the ChatGPT project's Instructions.
Claude: in Settings ▸ Capabilities ▸ Skills, remove the old skill and upload the new dse-econ-graph.zip.
zh: 重新下載 zip（dse-econ-graph.zip；ChatGPT 用 dse-econ-graph-chatgpt.zip）。
Grok：在「插件」▸「技能」刪除舊的 dse-econ-graph 技能，上載新的 dse-econ-graph.zip。ChatGPT：在 Plugins ▸ Upload plugin 上載新的 dse-econ-graph-chatgpt.zip。如指示文字有更新，把新文字貼到 ChatGPT 專案的 Instructions（指示）。
Claude：在 Settings ▸ Capabilities ▸ Skills 刪除舊技能，上載新的 dse-econ-graph.zip。

gallery.title: Price set BELOW equilibrium (price ceiling / fixed low price) -> shortage.
gallery.title_zh: 低於均衡價格的價格上限：短缺

gallery.title: Minimum wage ABOVE equilibrium in a labour market -> unemployment.
gallery.title_zh: 高於均衡工資的最低工資：失業

gallery.title: Price fixed BELOW equilibrium; demand increases -> shortage grows.
gallery.title_zh: 價格固定於均衡價格以下而需求增加：短缺擴大

gallery.title: Perfectly inelastic (vertical) supply, price set BELOW equilibrium -> shortage.
gallery.title_zh: 垂直供應及低於均衡價格的價格：短缺

gallery.title: Price falls on ELASTIC (flat) demand -> total revenue rises.
gallery.title_zh: 富彈性需求下價格下降：總收入增加

gallery.title: Supply decreases on INELASTIC (steep) demand -> total revenue rises.
gallery.title_zh: 缺乏彈性需求下供應減少：總收入增加

gallery.title: Per-unit tax: incidence and tax revenue.
gallery.title_zh: 從量稅：稅負分擔及政府稅收

gallery.title: A quota (Qq) set BELOW the equilibrium quantity (Qe): consumer surplus, producer surplus and deadweight loss.
gallery.title_zh: 低於均衡數量的配額：消費者盈餘、生產者盈餘及無謂損失

gallery.title: Negative externality in production: overproduction and deadweight loss.
gallery.title_zh: 生產的負外部效應：生產過多及無謂損失

gallery.title: Production possibilities curve (PPC) and economic growth.
gallery.title_zh: 生產可能曲線：效率、失業及經濟增長

gallery.title: Demand increases -> price and quantity both rise -> total revenue increases (shade the change only).
gallery.title_zh: 需求增加：總收入的增加

gallery.title: Demand decreases -> price and quantity fall.
gallery.title_zh: 需求減少：價格及數量下降

gallery.title: Supply decreases -> price rises, quantity falls.
gallery.title_zh: 供應減少：價格上升，數量下降

gallery.title: Demand and supply both increase, demand by MORE -> price rises.
gallery.title_zh: 需求及供應同時增加而需求增幅較大：價格上升

gallery.title: Fixed stock (vertical supply): supply rises a little, demand rises a lot -> price rises.
gallery.title_zh: 垂直供應稍為增加而需求大幅增加：價格上升

gallery.title: Imported workers: labour supply rises -> wage falls, LOCAL employment falls.
gallery.title_zh: 輸入勞工：工資及本地就業下降

gallery.title: Demand decreases -> price and quantity both fall -> total revenue falls (shade the change only).
gallery.title_zh: 需求減少：總收入的減少

gallery.title: Price rises on INELASTIC (steep) demand -> total revenue rises.
gallery.title_zh: 缺乏彈性需求下價格上升：總收入增加

gallery.title: Fixed stock (vertical supply) increases on ELASTIC (flat) demand -> total value rises.
gallery.title_zh: 富彈性需求下的士牌照增加：牌照總值上升

gallery.title: Wage fixed BELOW equilibrium; labour supply increases -> excess demand for labour shrinks.
gallery.title_zh: 工資固定於均衡工資以下而勞工供應增加：超額需求減少

gallery.title: Vertical supply; the fixed price is raised but stays below equilibrium -> shortage shrinks.
gallery.title_zh: 垂直供應，固定價格提高但仍低於均衡價格：短缺減少

gallery.title: Price fixed ABOVE equilibrium; demand falls -> quantity sold and sales revenue fall.
gallery.title_zh: 價格固定於均衡價格以上而需求減少：銷售收入減少

gallery.title: Vertical supply; the controlled rent is raised but stays below equilibrium -> total rental payment rises.
gallery.title_zh: 垂直供應而管制租金提高：總租金支出增加

gallery.title: Price ceiling BELOW equilibrium -> shortage and deadweight loss.
gallery.title_zh: 低於均衡價格的價格上限：短缺及無謂損失

gallery.title: Price (fare / price floor) set ABOVE equilibrium -> excess supply and deadweight loss.
gallery.title_zh: 高於均衡價格的價格下限：超額供應及無謂損失

gallery.title: Price ceiling BELOW equilibrium -> change in consumer surplus (gain "+" and loss "−").
gallery.title_zh: 價格上限：消費者盈餘的變化

gallery.title: A price ceiling is lowered further below equilibrium -> deadweight loss increases.
gallery.title_zh: 價格上限進一步降低：無謂損失增加

gallery.title: Per-unit subsidy: S shifts down, buyers pay less, sellers receive more, MC > MB.
gallery.title_zh: 從量津貼：買家支付較少，賣家收取較多

gallery.title: A quota is raised -> price falls, quantity rises, deadweight loss shrinks.
gallery.title_zh: 配額提高：價格下降，無謂損失減少

gallery.title: Demand rises under a quota -> quantity stays at the quota, deadweight loss grows.
gallery.title_zh: 配額下需求增加：無謂損失增加

gallery.title: Unit tax on a good with inelastic (steep) demand: buyers bear more, deadweight loss "a".
gallery.title_zh: 缺乏彈性需求下的從量稅：買家負擔較多，無謂損失 a

gallery.title: Consumer surplus and producer surplus at the market equilibrium.
gallery.title_zh: 均衡時的消費者盈餘及生產者盈餘

gallery.title: Marginal cost rises -> supply shifts up -> total social surplus falls by area abE1E0.
gallery.title_zh: 邊際成本上升：總社會盈餘減少

gallery.title: Aggregate demand increases -> price level and real output both rise.
gallery.title_zh: 總需求增加：物價水平及實質產出上升

gallery.title: Short-run aggregate supply decreases -> price level rises, real output falls.
gallery.title_zh: 短期總供應減少：物價水平上升，實質產出下降

gallery.title: AD and SRAS both decrease -> real output falls; the price level is indeterminate.
gallery.title_zh: 總需求及短期總供應同時減少：實質產出下降，物價水平可升可跌

gallery.title: Long run: AD increases on a vertical LRAS -> price level rises, real output stays at Yf.
gallery.title_zh: 長期：垂直 LRAS 下總需求增加，只有物價水平上升

gallery.title: Economic growth: LRAS and AD both increase -> real output rises; P rises if AD grows more.
gallery.title_zh: 經濟增長：長期總供應及總需求同時增加

gallery.title: Deflationary gap narrows: AD increases -> real output rises towards Yf.
gallery.title_zh: 總需求增加：通縮缺口收窄

gallery.title: Inflationary gap closed by a fall in AD -> real output falls back to Yf.
gallery.title_zh: 總需求減少：通脹缺口消除

gallery.title: Deflationary gap closed by market forces: SRAS increases -> price level falls, output rises to Yf.
gallery.title_zh: 市場力量消除通縮缺口：短期總供應增加

gallery.title: Inflationary gap closed by market forces: SRAS decreases -> price level rises, output falls to Yf.
gallery.title_zh: 市場力量消除通脹缺口：短期總供應減少

gallery.title: Temporary supply shock: SRAS falls (1), then recovers (2) -> P and Y return to P0 and Yf.
gallery.title_zh: 短暫的供應衝擊：短期總供應先減少後回復
